name: Smartgloves II

sources.title: Rokoko Smartgloves product page (Smartgloves I vs Smartgloves II, FAQ)
sources.covers: sensor fusion and sensors per glove, IMU capture rate, wrist tracking accuracy, connectivity

note: Finger and wrist motion-capture gloves: "a proprietary combination of IMU (inertial measurement unit) and EMF (electro-magnetic field) sensor fusion technology - 7 sensors per glove". Smartgloves II: "IMU capture rate 250 Hz" (Smartgloves I: 166.67 Hz); "Wrist tracking accuracy has improved 3×, from 1.5mm to 0.47mm at fingertip distance" (accuracy_mm 0.47, as stated); "TCP-based WiFi streaming". Not stated: latency (the page says "low-latency" without a figure), DoF, mass, range (only "Twice the effective range with Coil Pro").

tracking_hz.quote: "IMU capture rate | 166.67 Hz | 250 Hz" (Smartgloves I | Smartgloves II)

accuracy_mm.quote: "Wrist tracking accuracy has improved 3×, from 1.5mm to 0.47mm at fingertip distance."
